rationale: Colin's deep expertise in AI infrastructure, developer relations, and ecosystem building at Nebius complements Dzianis's hands-on web3 and developer-tools engineering background from Coinbase. While Dzianis operates lower in the stack as a software engineer, Colin's conviction around engineered inference as competitive advantage and community-led adoption strategies could inform how Dzianis approaches building or scaling developer tooling in the fintech-b2b and web3 space.
intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Dzianis — Colin's background bridging GPU cloud infrastructure with builders, plus his developer relations playbook, could be valuable context as you continue building developer-focused tools in web3.
